workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
locale is the exact bundled code 'es': 'es-ES' silently hyphenates with the American patterns (cabal-los, hi-erro, establec-imiento on these pages)
resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes('es') by hand, because config.locale leaves the captions as 'Figure 1.1'
every frontmatter value is quoted (title and author feed the running heads)
the lead's design-text lineHeight is the multiple LEAD / BODY, never a Dimension, which would drop the opener's reservation

the plate's heading style restates breakBefore with parity 'any': it would inherit the chapter level's break, so with parity 'odd' the map would move to a recto behind a blank page and face another blank page
the nota style stays in ink: a paragraph style has no italicColor, so its italic Marianela would print darker than a muted note
col() writes the hex beside the paletteId, because design slots (opener, heads, plate) do not read the palette

design text has no justification, so the lead beside the initial is a single line whose gap (INITIAL_GAP 0.55 mm) is copy-fitted to end flush with the measure; a three-line drop cap would set three ragged lines
a design text's dropCap is drawn only when overflow is 'wrap' (the default 'ellipsis-end' drops the initial with no warning), so the lead sets overflow: 'wrap' though it is one line
